name: Ambiguous dates, times, names, and self-corrections

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent asks for clarification when the patient gives unclear dates, times, names, or symptoms and self-corrects, instead of guessing or locking in the wrong details.

patient.name: Sam Rivera
patient.clarified_symptoms: migraine-like headache on the left side
patient.preferred_date_unclear: sometime next week, maybe Wednesday or Thursday

conversation_beats: Ask to schedule because of a 'bad head thing' without naming the symptom clearly at first.
When pressed, say it might be a headache, then correct yourself to a migraine-like headache on the left side.
Request an appointment 'sometime next week, maybe Wednesday or Thursday.'
Say 'around lunchtime' without a specific clock time.
If the agent guesses a day or time, correct them and settle on Thursday at 12:30 PM.
Give your name unclearly once ('Sam... Rivera? Rivera') then confirm Sam Rivera and DOB 1992-02-17.
